headline: Central Bank of Turkey Reverses Course to Raise 2027 Inflation Targets
summary: The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey (TCMB) updated its inflation forecasts and interim targets upward in its final Inflation Report of the year, signalling elevated inflation risks through 2027.
why: The TCMB manages Turkish monetary policy, navigating elevated domestic price pressures and local currency exchange dynamics.

entities.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey

impacts.name: Turkish Lira
impacts.why: Upwardly revised inflation projections pressure the real value of the Turkish lira.
